tools.name: add_contact
tools.description: Add a new contact person to contact database. Entries with identical information are allowed, and will be assigned different person_ids.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name of contact person.

arguments.name: phone_number
arguments.description: Phone number of contact person.

arguments.name: relationship
arguments.description: Optional. Relationship between user and this contact.

arguments.name: is_self
arguments.description: Optional. Defaults to False. Should be set to True if the contact corresponds to the current user.

returns.description: String format unique identifier for the contact person (person_id). This can be passed to other functions which require a unique identifier for this contact person.

tools.side_effects: Creates a new entry in the contact database. Raises DuplicateError if a self entry already exists and is_self is True.

tools.name: modify_contact
tools.description: Modify a contact entry with new information provided. At least one field among name, phone_number, relationship, is_self must be provided.

arguments.name: person_id
arguments.description: String unique identifier for the contact person.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: New name for the person.

arguments.name: phone_number
arguments.description: New phone number for the person.

arguments.name: relationship
arguments.description: New relationship for the person.

arguments.name: is_self
arguments.description: Should be set to True if the contact corresponds to the current user.

returns.description: Returns None.

tools.side_effects: Updates the matching contact entry in the database. Raises ValueError if no update fields are provided, NoDataError if person_id not found, DuplicateError if modifying to self when a self entry already exists.

tools.name: remove_contact
tools.description: Remove an existing contact person from the contact database.

arguments.name: person_id
arguments.description: String format unique identifier of the person to be deleted.

returns.description: Returns None.

tools.side_effects: Removes the contact entry from the database. Raises NoDataError if the provided person_id was not found.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search for a contact person based on provided arguments. Uses exact matching for person_id, phone_number, and is_self. Uses fuzzy string matching for name and relationship (relationship threshold=90). Returns all contact entries matching all provided criteria.

arguments.name: person_id
arguments.description: String format unique identifier for the contact person. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name of contact person. Will be fuzzy matched.

arguments.name: phone_number
arguments.description: Phone number of contact person. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: relationship
arguments.description: Relationship between user and this contact. Will be fuzzy matched (threshold=90).

arguments.name: is_self
arguments.description: If the requested contact corresponds to the current user. Will be exact matched.

returns.description: A list of matching Contact objects. An empty list if no matching contacts were found.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a read-only tool.

tools.name: send_message_with_phone_number
tools.description: Send a message to a recipient using phone_number. Requires cellular service to be enabled. Automatically resolves the sender from the self contact entry.

arguments.name: phone_number
arguments.description: String format phone number to send the message to.

arguments.name: content
arguments.description: Message payload text.

returns.description: String format unique identifier for the message (message_id). This can be passed to other functions which require a unique identifier for this message.

tools.side_effects: Creates a new message entry in the messaging database with sender, recipient, content, and creation timestamp. Raises ConnectionError if cellular service is not enabled.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search for a message based on provided arguments. Uses exact matching for message_id, sender_person_id, sender_phone_number, recipient_person_id, recipient_phone_number. Uses fuzzy string matching for content (threshold=50). Uses range matching for creation timestamps with lowerbound and upperbound.

arguments.name: message_id
arguments.description: String format unique identifier for message. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: sender_person_id
arguments.description: String format unique identifier for the sender. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: sender_phone_number
arguments.description: Phone number for the sender. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: recipient_person_id
arguments.description: String format unique identifier for the recipient. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: recipient_phone_number
arguments.description: Phone number for the recipient. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: content
arguments.description: Message content. Will be fuzzy matched (threshold=50).

arguments.name: creation_timestamp_lowerbound
arguments.description: Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the message was created.

arguments.name: creation_timestamp_upperbound
arguments.description: Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the message was created.

returns.description: A list of matching Message objects. An empty list if no matching messages were found.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a read-only tool.

tools.name: add_reminder
tools.description: Add a reminder. A creation timestamp is automatically recorded.

arguments.name: content
arguments.description: Content of the reminder.

arguments.name: reminder_timestamp
arguments.description: When the user wants to be reminded. Expressed in POSIX timestamp.

arguments.name: latitude
arguments.description: Optional. Latitude of the location associated with this reminder.

arguments.name: longitude
arguments.description: Optional. Longitude of the location associated with this reminder.

returns.description: String format unique identifier for the reminder (reminder_id). This can be passed to other functions which require a unique identifier for this reminder.

tools.side_effects: Creates a new reminder entry in the reminder database with content, creation_timestamp, reminder_timestamp, latitude, and longitude.

tools.name: modify_reminder
tools.description: Modify a reminder with new information provided. Creation timestamp is updated automatically. At least one field among content, reminder_timestamp, latitude, longitude must be provided.

arguments.name: reminder_id
arguments.description: String format unique identifier of the reminder to be modified.

arguments.name: content
arguments.description: New content for the reminder.

arguments.name: reminder_timestamp
arguments.description: When the user wants to be reminded. Expressed in POSIX timestamp.

arguments.name: latitude
arguments.description: Latitude of the location associated with this reminder. Can be set to null to remove.

arguments.name: longitude
arguments.description: Longitude of the location associated with this reminder. Can be set to null to remove.

returns.description: Returns None.

tools.side_effects: Updates the matching reminder entry in the database and refreshes the creation timestamp. Raises ValueError if no update fields provided, NoDataError if reminder_id not found, DuplicateError if multiple entries with same id.

tools.name: search_reminder
tools.description: Search for a reminder based on provided arguments. Uses exact matching for reminder_id, latitude, longitude. Uses fuzzy string matching for content (threshold=50). Uses range matching for creation and reminder timestamps with lowerbound and upperbound.

arguments.name: reminder_id
arguments.description: String format unique identifier for the reminder. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: content
arguments.description: Content of the reminder. Will be fuzzy matched (threshold=50).

arguments.name: creation_timestamp_lowerbound
arguments.description: Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder was created.

arguments.name: creation_timestamp_upperbound
arguments.description: Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of the time the reminder was created.

arguments.name: reminder_timestamp_lowerbound
arguments.description: Lowerbound of the POSIX timestamp of when the reminder should fire.

arguments.name: reminder_timestamp_upperbound
arguments.description: Upperbound of the POSIX timestamp of when the reminder should fire.

arguments.name: latitude
arguments.description: Latitude of the location associated with the reminder. Will be exact matched.

arguments.name: longitude
arguments.description: Longitude of the location associated with the reminder. Will be exact matched.

returns.description: A list of matching Reminder objects. An empty list if no matching reminders were found.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a read-only tool.

tools.name: remove_reminder
tools.description: Remove a reminder given its unique identifier.

arguments.name: reminder_id
arguments.description: String format unique identifier of the reminder to be removed.

returns.description: Returns None.

tools.side_effects: Removes the reminder entry from the database. Raises NoDataError if the provided reminder_id was not found.

tools.name: set_low_battery_mode_status
tools.description: Enable or disable low battery mode. When turned on, automatically disables cellular, wifi, and location_service. While low battery mode is on, those services cannot be re-enabled.

arguments.name: on
arguments.description: If true, turn on low battery mode. If false, turn it off.

returns.description: Returns None.

tools.side_effects: Toggles the low_battery_mode setting. When turning on, also disables cellular, wifi, and location_service. Raises ValueError if low battery mode is already in the requested state.

tools.name: get_low_battery_mode_status
tools.description: Request low battery mode status.

returns.description: Boolean indicating if low battery mode is on.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a read-only tool.

tools.name: set_location_service_status
tools.description: Enable or disable location service. Cannot be turned on while low battery mode is active.

arguments.name: on
arguments.description: If true, turn on location service. If false, turn it off.

returns.description: Returns None.

tools.side_effects: Toggles the location_service setting. Raises ValueError if already in the requested state. Raises PermissionError if low battery mode is on and attempting to enable.

tools.name: get_location_service_status
tools.description: Request location service status.

returns.description: Boolean indicating if the location service is on.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a read-only tool.

tools.name: set_cellular_service_status
tools.description: Enable or disable cellular service. Cannot be turned on while low battery mode is active.

arguments.name: on
arguments.description: If true, turn on cellular service. If false, turn it off.

returns.description: Returns None.

tools.side_effects: Toggles the cellular service setting. Raises ValueError if already in the requested state. Raises PermissionError if low battery mode is on and attempting to enable.

tools.name: get_cellular_service_status
tools.description: Request cellular service status.

returns.description: Boolean indicating if the cellular service is on.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a read-only tool.

tools.name: set_wifi_status
tools.description: Enable or disable wifi. Cannot be turned on while low battery mode is active.

arguments.name: on
arguments.description: If true, turn on wifi. If false, turn it off.

returns.description: Returns None.

tools.side_effects: Toggles the wifi setting. Raises ValueError if already in the requested state. Raises PermissionError if low battery mode is on and attempting to enable.

tools.name: get_wifi_status
tools.description: Request wifi status.

returns.description: Boolean indicating if wifi is on.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a read-only tool.

tools.name: get_current_location
tools.description: Request current location latitude and longitude. Requires location service to be enabled.

returns.description: A dictionary containing 'latitude' and 'longitude' (both floats) of the current location.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a read-only tool. Raises PermissionError if location_service is not turned on.

tools.name: get_current_timestamp
tools.description: Get current POSIX timestamp.

returns.description: Float value POSIX timestamp representing the current time.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a pure computation tool.

tools.name: timestamp_to_datetime_info
tools.description: Convert POSIX timestamp to a dictionary of date time information, including year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and isoweekday. isoweekday ranges from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday).

arguments.name: timestamp
arguments.description: Float representing POSIX timestamp.

returns.description: A dictionary containing year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and isoweekday (all integers).

tools.side_effects: None. This is a pure computation tool.

tools.name: datetime_info_to_timestamp
tools.description: Convert date time information to POSIX timestamp.

arguments.name: year
arguments.description: Year of timestamp.

arguments.name: month
arguments.description: Month of timestamp.

arguments.name: day
arguments.description: Day of timestamp.

arguments.name: hour
arguments.description: Hour of timestamp in 24hr format.

arguments.name: minute
arguments.description: Minute of timestamp.

arguments.name: second
arguments.description: Second of timestamp.

returns.description: POSIX timestamp as a float.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a pure computation tool.

tools.name: shift_timestamp
tools.description: Shifts a POSIX timestamp by provided deltas. Delta can be positive or negative.

arguments.name: timestamp
arguments.description: POSIX timestamp to be shifted.

arguments.name: weeks
arguments.description: Number of weeks to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

arguments.name: days
arguments.description: Number of days to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

arguments.name: hours
arguments.description: Number of hours to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

arguments.name: minutes
arguments.description: Number of minutes to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

arguments.name: seconds
arguments.description: Number of seconds to add or subtract. Defaults to 0.

returns.description: A shifted POSIX timestamp with deltas applied.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a pure computation tool.

tools.name: timestamp_diff
tools.description: Calculates the difference between two timestamps (timestamp_1 - timestamp_0), returned as days and seconds.

arguments.name: timestamp_0
arguments.description: POSIX timestamp to subtract.

arguments.name: timestamp_1
arguments.description: POSIX timestamp to subtract from.

returns.description: A dictionary containing the difference with keys 'days' (int) and 'seconds' (int).

tools.side_effects: None. This is a pure computation tool.

tools.name: seconds_to_hours_minutes_seconds
tools.description: Convert total number of seconds past 0:00 into hours, minutes and seconds.

arguments.name: seconds
arguments.description: Number of seconds past 0:00.

returns.description: A dictionary with keys 'hour', 'minute', 'second' (all integers).

tools.side_effects: None. This is a pure computation tool.

tools.name: unit_conversion
tools.description: Convert a certain amount from one unit to another. Accepts common english names for units (e.g. celsius, fahrenheit).

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: Float point amount in from_unit.

arguments.name: from_unit
arguments.description: Unit to convert from. For example 'celsius'.

arguments.name: to_unit
arguments.description: Unit to convert to. For example 'fahrenheit'.

returns.description: Converted amount as a float.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a pure computation tool. Raises UndefinedUnitError if unable to parse unit names, ValueError if unable to convert between provided units.

tools.name: calculate_lat_lon_distance
tools.description: Calculate the distance between 2 pairs of latitude and longitude.

arguments.name: latitude_0
arguments.description: First Latitude.

arguments.name: longitude_0
arguments.description: First Longitude.

arguments.name: latitude_1
arguments.description: Second Latitude.

arguments.name: longitude_1
arguments.description: Second Longitude.

returns.description: Distance between the 2 pairs in kilometers.

tools.side_effects: None. This is a pure computation tool.

data_models.description: Reference data models used as argument or return types by the tools above.

Contact.description: A contact person entry in the contact database.

person_id.description: Unique identifier for the contact person (UUID).

phone_number.description: Phone number of the contact person.

relationship.description: Relationship between user and this contact.

is_self.description: True if the contact corresponds to the current user.

Message.description: A message entry in the messaging database.

sender_person_id.description: Unique identifier of the sender contact.

recipient_person_id.description: Unique identifier of the recipient contact.

creation_timestamp.description: POSIX timestamp of when the message was created.

Reminder.description: A reminder entry in the reminder database.

creation_timestamp.description: POSIX timestamp of when the reminder was created.

reminder_timestamp.description: POSIX timestamp of when the user wants to be reminded.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location associated with this reminder.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location associated with this reminder.

DateTimeInfo.description: A dictionary of date time components derived from a POSIX timestamp.

TimeDelta.description: A time difference represented as days and seconds.

days.description: Number of whole days in the difference.

TimeComponents.description: Time broken into hour, minute, and second components.

tool_type_legend.read: Retrieves information from the database or external service without modifying any state.
tool_type_legend.write: Modifies the database state (creates, updates, or deletes records). The agent must confirm with the user before calling write tools.
tool_type_legend.generic: General-purpose utility that may or may not involve state changes depending on context.
